qualified_claim: For the frozen B01 and O14 dry-profile constant-supply fixtures, an initially dry-admissible interval that becomes complementarity-inadmissible can be handled transactionally with one dry full-interval predictor, one constrained event-state/event-time corrector and one ponded remainder solve. The event is localized strictly inside the frozen bracket, the event state has h_surface=0 and negative soil heads, only the final composed interval is published, and complete mass balance closes far below the frozen 1e-9 cm gate without repair.

architecture_checks.3_explicit_data_separation: Committed state, forcing, event diagnostics, scratch and results remain separate.
architecture_checks.4_compact_persistent_state: No event-time or duplicate event-state is persisted per column.
architecture_checks.5_scratch_per_worker: Predictor, event corrector and remainder vectors are worker-owned scratch.
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Predictor and event state are uncommitted; synthetic post-event rejection restores the original committed state; final publication occurs once.
architecture_checks.8_warm_start: Predictor may seed the event corrector, while event residuals originate from the original committed physical state.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: Event times are generic offsets inside [t0,t1], not calendar boundaries.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Worst accepted whole-interval residual is 3.75e-15 cm; no repair or clipping.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: Event composition uses soil-step and surface-face contracts rather than HeadCalc internals.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Complementarity defines the physical event; least_squares and fixed trajectory count are qualification numerical policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: Exactly three nonlinear trajectories per candidate path; no repeated full-trajectory bisection event search.
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: Event bracket/time, residuals, nfev, mode sequence and balances are explicit.

hard_nonclaims: No production runtime cost qualification; three trajectories are only a restricted bounded qualification path.
No top soil-node h=0 or positive-head state qualification.
No runoff with real soil state.
No response tangent across the boundary switch.
No MultiSWAP, MODFLOW or groundwater admission.
